                count = 1
                j = (k_param * i) % total_p
                m = inv_k_param
                while not visited_array[j]:
                    visited_array[j] = True
                    count += 1

                    j = (k_param * j) % total_p
                if m == 1:
                    total_ans = (total_ans * total_p) % MOD_CONST
    else:
        for i in range(1, total_p):
            total_ans = (total_ans * total_p) % MOD_CONST

    print(total_ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
